opening.argument: The presenter frames the video as a discussion of talented people in Dalit society, moving from Mayawati in politics to cricket. The title likewise presents notable figures, including Rajinikanth and Mayawati, as the subject. The presenter asks viewers to show the video to children and teach them that there are talented people in their society. Those are signals of an educational discussion across public life, entertainment, and sports, not a financial offer. The reference to showing the video to others is an audience-engagement request; nothing in the supplied evidence makes sharing a condition for payment, investment, submitting credentials, or any other financial participation.
